chen400_reconstruction.consumer: FIXED_GAIN * physical_w_per_pixel against task target; MSE and optional structural term are unclipped
chen400_reconstruction.gain: fixed constant in the A/B script, not the v9 QE/exposure/full-well camera model
chen400_reconstruction.power_loss: no separate L_op term in this finite-pixel A/B objective

matched_architecture.consumer: unclipped physical_w_per_pixel * fixed camera_gain against task target
matched_architecture.gain: fit once by the script calibration path using its training population, then frozen; not a measured camera calibration
matched_architecture.power_loss: mean squared log ratio of plane_powers_w to frozen per-plane references

legacy_semantic_ols.consumer: raw_intensity directly in image reconstruction; this output is not the v9 W/pixel/electron readout
legacy_semantic_ols.power_loss: optical term is explicitly zero in this training path
legacy_semantic_ols.compatibility: does not consume v9 W/pixel, electron-count, or clipped proxy-camera output

training_consumer_audit.interpretation: separate research paths with different consumers; no loss or checkpoint is migrated by this audit

local_source_audit_supplement.provenance: Added after retrieval from direct source inspection; cloud numerical report is preserved unchanged at the run path.

legacy_semantic_ols.pixel_area_integration: not performed in this producer path after abs(field)^2
legacy_semantic_ols.unit_status: unspecified; IntensityFrame stores tensor, plane, provenance and optional exposure_id, but no unit field (src/ldm_project/v2/contracts/planes.py:127-133)
legacy_semantic_ols.consumer: MSE(result.raw_intensity, aligned image target); L_optical is explicitly zero
legacy_semantic_ols.fixed_camera_gain_exposure_or_QE: not applied in this reconstruction consumer
legacy_semantic_ols.v9_proxy_camera_compatibility: does not consume W/pixel, electron count, or clipped fixed-exposure output

matched_architecture.producer: quadrature pixel irradiance times pixel area yields physical_w_per_pixel; raw irradiance is also retained as W/m^2
matched_architecture.gain: global scalar least-squares fit during TRAIN calibration, then frozen; simulation fit, not measured camera calibration
matched_architecture.L_op: mean squared log ratio of each plane power in W to the per-plane TRAIN-frozen reference; not a coupling-maximization term

chen400_reconstruction.producer: finite-pixel quadrature intensity times pixel area, W/pixel
chen400_reconstruction.reconstruction: script FIXED_GAIN times physical_w_per_pixel against target, unclipped MSE; optional structural term is separate
chen400_reconstruction.gain: fixed script constant; not the v9 QE/exposure/full-well proxy calibration
chen400_reconstruction.power_loss: no separate L_op in this finite-pixel A/B objective

local_source_audit_supplement.interfaces_not_transferred: No formal training entrypoint, checkpoint, camera gain, power reference, or OLS statistical reference was modified or migrated.
